purpose: Known AE version feature boundaries. These contracts explain expected blocked or skipped matrix cells so coverage and cleanup do not treat them as unexplained failures.

version_boundaries.feature: AE2025 explicit track matte source references
version_boundaries.expansion_policy: when AE2026 or newer is added, rerun the layer matrix and update supported_targets or blocked_downgrade_targets from evidence
notes: AE2020 through AE2024 source projects skip this recipe because the source contract is unavailable before AE2025.
AE2025 source projects pass only when the target remains AE2025 and are blocked for AE2020 through AE2024 downgrade targets.
